prs.description: Updates the README with accurate usage examples.

changes.content:
# caic-pr-review-test

Test repository for the Carbon Monitor caic eval.

## Usage

```html
<example-chat-button>Send</example-chat-button>
<example-message-list></example-message-list>
```

## Components

- `example-chat-button` — a Carbon Web Components button wrapper
- `example-message-list` — a list of formatted messages

prs.title: B4: intentional change with explanation in description
prs.description: Removes the default max length cap entirely. The PR description explains: the calling layer now enforces its own limit, so the util must not double-truncate.

prs.title: B5: partial implementation — linked issue has unmet items
prs.description: Fixes the trim behaviour in formatMessage. The linked issue also asked for locale-aware truncation, but that is tracked separately.

prs.title: B6: alternative valid truncation approach
prs.description: Uses Intl.Segmenter for grapheme-aware truncation — a different but equally valid approach.
